name: podium-hook
description: Native hook client for Claude Code — POSTs hook events to every live Podium dashboard server. Port of Sources/PodiumHook (Swift) for the Node/Bun era (N5-B).

scripts.build: BUN_NO_CODESIGN_MACHO_BINARY=1 bun build --compile --outfile=dist/podium-hook src/index.ts && { [ "$(uname)" != Darwin ] || codesign -s - --force dist/podium-hook; }
